about: Plot data for the OM-workshop cost/benefit figures. One CSV per figure; values are exactly those plotted (derived columns such as capture_frac / spectrum_t / *_outlier are precomputed so the plots can be regenerated with no recomputation).
provenance: Extracted from Sviatoslav's 2026-06-24 HTML notebook exports (no raw CSVs existed) into analysis/sviatoslav_cost_benefit/data/, then reduced to the plotted series here. cost_usd_per_run = hosted API price per run on human-mouse (254 candidate mappings); yi = Youden's J = sensitivity+specificity-1; f1 = oracle F1.
regenerate: cd paper_om_workshop/data && python regenerate.py   (reads these CSVs + this manifest, writes ../figures/*.pdf). Upstream single source of truth: analysis/sviatoslav_cost_benefit/scripts/03_export_paper_assets.py

fig_oracle_value.plot: two panels: (a) grouped bar of F1 per task; (b) horizontal bar of capture_frac*100

fig_pareto.plot: scatter f1 vs cost_usd_per_run (log x); frontier line over on_pareto_frontier==True

columns.reasoning_share: reasoning tokens as fraction of cost

fig_cost_drivers.plot: horizontal bar: reasoning_share*100 per model (10 highest-cost)

fig_landscape.plot: scatter yi vs cost_usd_per_run (log x); grey where is_highlighted==False; else colour=spectrum_t (coolwarm 0..1); rings where is_selected_panel; star where efficiency_outlier; X where poor_value_outlier; frontier line over on_pareto_frontier

fig_tradeoffs.plot: Trade-offs view: (7) yi vs proc_time_s scatter, bubble=cost; (8) cost/yi & cost/f1 dot plot; feeds reliability chips. One row per model at its best-scoring human-mouse config.
fig_tradeoffs.source: tradeoffs.html cost/speed/reliability charts joined to the human-mouse cost rows of model_explorer.html (join key: model + cost + yi, which recovers f1).

columns.proc_time_s: mean wall-clock processing time per run (s)

fig_reliability.plot: Trade-offs Figure 9: horizontal bars of fail_rate or retries for the non-zero configs.
fig_reliability.source: tradeoffs.html 'Failure rate per model' + 'Average retries per call' charts (one row per model+config).

columns.retries: mean retries per call (blank where not charted)

cfg_reasoning.plot: Configuration Figure 10 heatmap: reasoning-effort level -> YI.

cfg_thinking.plot: Configuration Figure 11 heatmap (toggle YI / fail): thinking-token budget -> YI and fail_rate.
cfg_thinking.source: report.html 'Thinking budget -> Youden's index' and '-> fail_rate' heatmaps (unioned).

cfg_prompt.plot: Configuration Figure 12 heatmap: prompt template -> YI (baseline models).

cfg_fewshot.plot: Configuration Figure 13 lines: #few-shot examples -> mean YI.
cfg_fewshot.source: report.html 'Few-shot count -> mean Youden's index' heatmap.
